# Rule router contract — schema v2

Every non-kernel router entry carries workspaces and packs copied verbatim from rule frontmatter; kernel entries stay bare strings because the kernel is unconditional. Readers must ignore unknown keys so additive schema bumps stay non-breaking. The compiled router is byte-stable across clean builds; check-router gates it.
